rules: No value in this file was typed; each is read from a committed file or produced by the named computation using the recorded inputs.
Two exact-cell denominators exist: 10,925 (full) and 10,881 (restricted). Keys are suffixed .full / .restricted and must never be mixed on one axis.
status=OWED means the value could not be sourced. It is not an estimate. The figure must render a visible placeholder.
status=NA means the quantity does not exist for that arm (metacell arms have no per-cell correspondence). It must never be drawn as zero.

agg.declared_deviation.value: Aggregate-resolution pairs come from ArchR's TSS+/-250kb overlap on the 339,316-peak SCENIC+ consensus set; per-cell L1 pairs are SCENIC+'s own 1,630,166-pair search space. Counts are therefore NOT directly subtractable; percentages are the comparable form and both are reported.
